sourceText: Group the deferred defects from B-a745 by root cause into stories; build the single-owner extraction story (C) and the test-and-guard credibility story (D), then execute C first, then D, until completely done.
normalizedOutcome: In packages/main the rename-aware git diff reader, the legacy shell-versus-argv command parse, and story workspace resolution each have exactly one implementation that every consumer uses; a rename of a path git would C-quote keeps both sides, an unparseable diff row raises, DONE-required and routine parsing cannot disagree, and a committed audit fixture prints every handler that calls resolveGitCwd with whether it still reads story metadata or config from the invocation root.
acceptanceClaim: node packages/main/dist/tasks/single-owner-extraction-smoke.js ends with single-owner-extraction-smoke: PASS, covering the quoted-rename, malformed-row, parser-corpus, shared-resolver and call-site-audit cases, and each case was committed failing before its implementation commit.
